identity.model: Xbox One S (1TB claimed by seller; not readable in photos)

claims.evidence: Photos show an Xbox One S-style console, but the 1TB/storage label is not readable.

claims.claim: comes with one wireless controller and games installed in the console
claims.evidence: A controller is visible (photo 0), but installed games are not shown (no dashboard/game screen).

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No internal/serial/repair indicators are shown; cannot confirm from photos.
No temperature/usage test footage is provided.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No original pads/receipt are shown in the provided photos.

risks.risk: Storage size (1TB) not verifiable from photos; wrong capacity affects value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console storage/model label (or Settings > System > Storage screen showing total capacity).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a standard Xbox One S without confirmed 1TB.

risks.risk: Installed games claim not verifiable; could be minimal or none.
risks.proof: A video/shot of the Xbox dashboard showing the installed games list (My games & apps).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + controller only (no value added for games).

risks.risk: Ports may not work (HDMI/USB/Ethernet/audio), which is common for used consoles.
risks.proof: Short test clip showing HDMI output to TV and at least one USB device/controller charging/connection working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed (worst case: treat as needing testing).

risks.risk: Overheating/thermal issues not visible; could fail under load.
risks.proof: A 15–20 minute gameplay/benchmark clip with no shutdowns (or a temperature/usage test screenshot if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as normal used condition without assuming “no overheating.”

risks.risk: Original pads/UK receipt not shown; could be missing.
risks.proof: Photos of the original packaging/pads and the UK receipt (with sensitive info covered).
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming receipt/pads are included.

proof_requests: Photo of the console storage/model label or Settings > System > Storage showing total capacity (to confirm 1TB).
Screenshot/video of the Xbox dashboard showing installed games under “My games & apps.”
Video showing HDMI display working and at least one port test (USB + controller connection/charging).
A short gameplay test clip (15–20 minutes) to confirm no overheating/shutdowns.
Photos of the original pads/packaging and the UK receipt.
response.reason: The photos confirm an Xbox One S-style console and a controller, but the key value drivers (1TB capacity, installed games, port functionality, and receipt/pads) are not verifiable remotely from the provided images.
